headline: Russian MoD claims logistics + cargo-vessel hits at Reni
dek: Ukrainian State Emergency Service: Russian attacks Tuesday killed 3 and injured 11 in Kyiv (Obukhiv production/storage facility) and Kharkiv (Izium drone strike). Russian Defense Ministry: struck logistics centers at Khmelnytskyi and Kovel (Volyn), 3 cargo vessels unloading at port of Reni…
sources: Ukrainian State Emergency Service (casualty numbers) via AA/TRT; Russian Defense Ministry (logistics/vessel strike claims); Ukrainian Air Force implied for drone tallies
fault_line: US support reliability: is Washington abandoning Ukraine (Trump-Zelensky fallout, Starlink/intel disruption, Patriot delays) just as Russia escalates?

sections.what_happened: Ukrainian State Emergency Service: Russian attacks Tuesday killed 3 and injured 11 in Kyiv (Obukhiv production/storage facility) and Kharkiv (Izium drone strike). Russian Defense Ministry: struck logistics centers at Khmelnytskyi and Kovel (Volyn), 3 cargo vessels unloading at port of Reni (Odesa), and a cargo vessel en route to Odesa; claims 136 Ukrainian drones intercepted across 15 Russian regions overnight. Ukrinform: 848 strikes on 52 Zaporizhzhia settlements in past day (1 killed, 5 injured). Mid-day variant tally: 16 ballistic missiles + 200+ drones nationwide, 10+ energy facilities damaged, 500k households cut from power (casualty tallies differ across outlets: 3 vs 6 vs 10 dead).
sections.what_verified: Ukrainian casualty numbers (3 dead, 11 injured) carried by multiple outlets (AA, TRT, Ukrinform, Yeni Safak); Russian vessel/logistics claims carried only as Russian MoD statements.
sections.what_disputed: Casualty totals differ across outlets (3/6/10) — suggests overlapping waves/tallies not reconciled; Russian MoD strike claims are single-source with no independent confirmation; vessel-strike claim unverified by ship-tracking or Ukrainian sources.
sections.why_matters: Map explainer: Russia's interdiction campaign moving from power grid to maritime logistics (Reni cargo vessels) — connect to pocketbook angle (households blacked out) and the Congress-vs-administration split from 1100-04.
sections.context: Background: Russia overnight strike wave on Ukraine Oct 19->20: 3 killed, 11 injured; Russian MoD claims logistics + cargo-vessel hits at Reni
